main_text.p: cenorum quod in calce Alcorani Latine versi habetur, edidit, sc. Non posse barbara illa Nomina recte instaurari sine libris Arabicis: Bene addit, Nec etiam multum in hac momenti est situm. Quod si vel aliquantillum infit, tabulam istam ex qua reponi possint, Lectoris oculis subjecimus.

Duplexque iis pariter convenit status, Ignorantiae alter, alter Islamismi.] Ita sc. tempora & conditionem Arabum, qui ante & post Mohammedem distinguunt, الجاهلية sive Ignorantiae, quem vocant, statum sic describit Ebnol Athir, esse sc. الحال التي كانت عليها العرب قبل الاسلام من الجهل بالله ورسوله وشرايع الدين والفاخرة بالانساب والكبر والتجبر وغير ذلك i. e. Statum in quo fuerunt Arabes ante Islamismum, quod ad ignorantiam Dei & Apostoli ejus & constitutionum religionis, & gloriationem de prosapia [nobilitate] & superbiam & fastum, &c. Islamismum autem vocant الطاعة والانقياد لله cum quis Obedientiam & submissionem Deo profiteatur. Vel ut rectius Moftafa Ebn Kassai in libro Taarifat. الاسلام هو الخضوع والانقياد بما اخبره الرسول is demum, Islamismus est, cum quis seiis quae à Mohammede tradita sint submittat & auscultet, seu religionem ab eo institutam amplectatur.

Ita sc. (referente Shareftanio) roganti Gabrieli speciem ac habitum Arabis induto, Quid esset Islamismus? Respondit Mohammedes, أن تشهد ان لا اله الا الله وان محمد رسول الله وان تقيم الصلوة وتؤتي الزكوة وتصوم شهر رمضان وتحج البيت ان استطعت اليه سبيلا . . . i. e. Ut confitearis non esse Deum praeter Deum illum, & Me esse Apostolum Dei, & ut tempora precum statuta diligenter observes, & Eleemosy-

page.notes: The Arabic passages are copied as far as legible. Several Arabic words in the second and third passages are uncertain (blurred at the scan edge and between lines) and are not marked individually; the Arabic line "ان استطعت اليه سبيلا" and the surrounding words should be checked against the original. The Latin text is clear. The phrase "Islamismi.]" with the closing bracket is printed as such. The line "Eleemosy-" ends with a printed hyphen; the word continues as "nam" in the catchword. The Arabic line ending "ان" near the end of the third passage is uncertain. Left margin: empty; no notes printed.
